question: 单项选择：By the time I was ten, I _____ 500 English words. A. learn  B. learned  C. have learned  D. had learned
answer: 答案：D. had learned。解析：By the time I was ten是过去时间，主句用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：I had finished dinner _____ he came. A. before  B. after  C. when  D. while
answer: 答案：A. before。解析：before引导时间状语从句。I had finished是过去完成时（过去的过去）。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (already, go) when I arrived.
answer: 答案：had already gone。解析：when I arrived是一般过去时，从句用过去完成时。完整：She had already gone when I arrived.

question: 单项选择：After he _____ the book, he went to bed. A. read  B. reads  C. has read  D. had read
answer: 答案：D. had read。解析：After引导时间状语从句，主句用过去完成时（过去的过去）。

question: 翻译句子：到去年为止，我已经学英语五年了。
answer: 答案：By last year, I had learned English for five years. 解析：By last year是过去时间，用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：He had never _____ a UFO before. A. see  B. saw  C. seen  D. sees
answer: 答案：C. seen。解析：过去完成时 + never，see的过去分词是seen。整句：He had never seen a UFO before.

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (just, finish) my homework when the phone rang.
answer: 答案：had just finished。解析：when the phone rang是一般过去时，从句用过去完成时。完整：I had just finished my homework when the phone rang.

question: 单项选择：By the end of last term, we _____ 1000 words. A. learn  B. learned  C. have learned  D. had learned
answer: 答案：D. had learned。解析：By the end of last term是过去时间，主句用过去完成时。

question: 翻译句子：他说他已经买了那本书。
answer: 答案：He said that he had already bought the book. 解析：said是过去时，从句用过去完成时。

question: 单项选择：Until she came, I _____ for two hours. A. wait  B. waited  C. have waited  D. had waited
answer: 答案：D. had waited。解析：Until she came是过去时，从句用过去完成时。for two hours"两小时"。
